subject: PrivDeploy packaging: escrow clause, milestone credits & support matrix
messages:
From: Ellen Wu <ellen@zenvera.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zenvera.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Escrow requirement + credits for pilot (Zenvera)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement and legal had a few items they want baked into any PrivDeploy quote so we can move the pilot forward this month:

- Escrow deposit / source-escrow access for the runtime binaries (we can provide a template).
- Milestone credit tied to go-live verification (30-day acceptance window).
- Clear support tiers and an SRE response SLA for Private (VPC) installs.

Can you outline commercial options that: (a) avoid a large up-front platform fee, or (b) provide credits that amortize the platform fee against committed usage and escrow milestones?

Attached: Zenvera_SOW_Reqs.pdf (high-level acceptance criteria).

We need a procurement-ready note by EOD Monday if possible — legal is expecting a strawman.

Thanks,
Ellen Wu
Director of Engineering Operations
Zenvera Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Wu <ellen@zenvera.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Escrow requirement + credits for pilot (Zenvera)

Ellen —

Appreciate the clear list. High level we can approach this two ways (short summary here; attaching a working pricing sheet):

Option A — Platform-fee with milestone credits
- One-time platform fee (amortized over 12 months) + per-token metered consumption.
- We offer a milestone credit equal to 25% of the platform fee if the escrow deposit is executed and Zenvera completes the 30-day acceptance tests within the acceptance window.
- Support: Standard Private Tier (P2) included; optional P3 SRE retainer for 24/7 on-call (priced separately).

Option B — Low/no upfront fee, committed consumption credits
- Minimal platform onboarding fee (covers packaging + initial testing).
- Commit to a 12-month consumption band; we provide upfront credits against the platform fee distributed over quarters and an escrow-triggered kicker if escrow & runbook acceptance are met.
- Support: P1 included; P2 / P3 are add-ons.

Escrow specifics we can accept:
- Redwood will agree to place a copy of the runtime in a third-party escrow (we have a standard term sheet).
- The escrow trigger for credits is the mutual execution of the escrow agreement and the delivery of a signed acceptance report.

Next steps I propose:
1) Rishi to share a numbers model for A vs B so you can see P&L impact.
2) Ben to draft a short SRE matrix showing response times and included hours for P1/P2/P3.
3) Legal exchange: we can convert our escrow term sheet into your template and flag any hard stops.

Attaching: proposed-packaging-v1.xlsx (working).

If Monday EOD is the ask, Rishi and I will prioritize and get a strawman over to procurement by then.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ellen Wu <ellen@zenvera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Escrow requirement + credits for pilot (Zenvera)

Ellen / team —

Quick numbers dump (high level — see attached workbook for line items):

Option A (Platform-fee with milestone credit)
- Platform fee: $240k one-time (amortized 12 mo = $20k/mo)
- Milestone credit: 25% of platform fee on escrow + acceptance = $60k credit applied to next invoice
- Estimated monthly consumption (pilot profile): $8k/mo after credits

Option B (Low upfront + committed credits)
- Onboarding fee: $30k one-time
- 12-mo consumption commitment: $240k total; we apply $60k in credits across Q1/Q2 if escrow + acceptance completed within 45 days
- Net effective first-year spend varies by consumption but modeled at $160–210k depending on token usage

Support matrix (summary):
- P1 (Included): Business hours support, 24h ticket SLA for sev1 triage, 72h workaround target.
- P2 (Recommended): 24/7 on-call, 4h sev1 response, monthly runbook review, included incident post-mortem (up to 3 incidents/year).
- P3 (SRE retainer): Dedicated engineer hours, guaranteed on-site or remote remediation windows, custom SLAs — priced as a retainer.

Escrow mechanics (commercially relevant):
- Credits are contingent on escrow execution + signed acceptance report. Redlines to the term sheet should not require source escrow release for routine debugging — only under insolvency/termination triggers.

I attached a redlined pricing model and a plain English summary. If Zenvera prefers Option B, we can show a quarter-by-quarter burn-down of credits so your finance team can model CAPEX vs OPEX exposure.

Attached: pricing-model.xlsx

Rishi
VP, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Wu <ellen@zenvera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@zenvera.com, procurement@zenvera.com
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Escrow requirement + credits for pilot (Zenvera)

Ellen —

Thanks — confirming we'll: 1) exchange redlines on the escrow term sheet (I've attached a short redline summary for your counsel), 2) circulate a pricing strawman (Rishi's workbook) and 3) send the P2 support matrix you requested.

A few clarifying points I want noted for your runbook and ops team: 
- The acceptance report should include three smoke-test items (integration auth, KV-cache replay of a representative session, and quantized model verification).
- Escrow execution + signed acceptance must be observable by both parties (we'll use the DocuSign envelope referenced below).

I'll put a short internal SOW amendment draft and the support-hours table in the Drive folder and share with your legal. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute procurement walk-through Monday morning to close open items.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
